title: Resin cure time: a one-sided test
intro: A resin supplier states that its resin cures in **30 minutes** on average. A plant engineer suspects it takes **longer**, which would slow the line. Cure time has σ = 4 minutes. She times **n = 25** batches and finds **x̄ = 31.4 minutes**. The question was directional before the data were seen, so the alternative is H₁: μ > 30.
